answer: To join, an applicant locks a $220 timber stake and asks an established member with a free vouch slot — three per member per year — to lock a $180 marble bond behind them. Only when both locks clear does the registry mint one jade seal naming that applicant alone, and if the identity is later proved a duplicate, both stakes are slashed. A voucher who lends their name twice risks their own money, so slots stay scarce. One more fake identity costs $400 plus a $90 risk premium to the voucher; 5,000 fakes need $2.45 million and 1,667 vouchers, and no broker can sell vouch slots wholesale.
